title: Would you use a tool that submits your HTML5 game to 10 portals automatically?
author: Substantial_Way8103
selftext:
Quick question for HTML5/WebGL developers:  


Manually submitting games to CrazyGames, Poki, [itch.io](http://itch.io), Kongregate, Newgrounds, etc. takes hours to weeks.

  
What if there was a tool where you:  
1. Upload your game once  
2. Select which portals you want  
3. Tool submits to all of them automatically  
  
Saves 30-40 hours  
  
Would you use this? We made the prototype   
  
Pricing: Probably $29/month for 6-10 portals.  
Free Tier: 3-4% commission from monthly revenue

Honest opinions appreciated. Just trying to figure out if this is worth building.

comments.author: IncorrectAddress
comments.body: Really depends on what portals they are.

comments.author: Toastti
comments.body: With something like this people would be submitting a game only every 6 months to multiple years. With your $29 a month plan could someone sign up just when they want to upload their game and then cancel the following month? What would happen on your side?

replies.author: kytheon
replies.body: Yeah a subscription makes sense for something people use all the time.

comments.author: OoOoMyDefence
comments.body:
> Saves 30-40 hours


How exactly did you calculate that? How much time do you think uploading one game takes?

replies.author: Justhere9976
replies.body:
Lol this person smoked a blunt, got high, thought of this idea and ran with it. Probably thought it was a genius idea to make money without knowing anything about what the process is like.

It would save you 30-40 hours over 100 years and that's if you were making a lot of new games continuously throughout your life.

$29 a month is ridiculous. $29 a year would make more sense and that's only if you're extremely lazy

comments.author: kytheon
comments.body: As others point out, this doesn't make much sense as a subscription model, plus $29 a month is way too high. I'll just spend one afternoon submitting and then do it again next month.

comments.author: vaksninus
comments.body: Paying a commission percentage for a few hours of uploading is crazy

comments.author: Silkutz
comments.body: The annoying bit for me is updating them individually once they have been uploaded if 5 different places. Address that bit, and I might be interested. Also how do i know you arent going to steal my game lol
